title: Find Center of Star Graph
description:
You are given an undirected graph that forms a star shape.

There are n nodes labeled from 1 to n
There is one center node
All other nodes are connected only to this center

You are given the edges of the graph.

Task

Find and return the center node.

Key Idea
The center node appears in every edge
So, it will be the common node between edges
Examples

Example 1

Input: [[1,2],[2,3],[4,2]]
Output: 2

Example 2

Input: [[1,2],[5,1],[1,3],[1,4]]
Output: 1
Constraints
3 ≤ n ≤ 100000
edges.length = n - 1
Each edge has 2 different nodes
Input always forms a valid star graph
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
